I need to make a decision in Monopoly.

I have $503 and am on PACIFIC_AVENUE. I own the full pink set and TENNESSEE_AVENUE. I have two of three orange properties, but p2 owns INDIANA so I lack a complete orange monopoly. I also own WATER_WORKS and a mortgaged PARK_PLACE.

p2 has $286 and owns Reading RR, Indiana (mortgaged), B&O RR, Marvin Gardens, NC Ave (mortgaged), and Boardwalk. p3 has $1011 and owns Med/Baltic with HOTELS, Electric Company, and Pacific Ave. p4 has $1435 and owns Oriental/Vermont/Connecticut with HOTELS, Virginia, Penn RR, Kentucky, Ventnor, Pennsylvania Ave, and Short Line. The Bank holds Illinois and Atlantic unowned. I will not unmortgage New York or Park Place.

Mortgaging the pink set and Water Works would yield $385. New York and Park Place are too expensive to unmortgage.

I mistakenly thought I owned the full pink set. p4 actually owns Virginia Avenue, so I only hold St. Charles Place and States Avenue. That is not a monopoly.

I own the full orange monopoly. St. James Place, Tennessee Avenue, and New York Avenue are all mine. New York is mortgaged, so I cannot build houses on it.

Unmortgaging New York costs $110, leaving $393. Building one house on each orange property would cost $300 and leave only $93. That is too little to survive rent from p4 or p3.

Three houses on the orange set would cost $900. After unmortgaging New York, I need $1010 total. I only have $503. Mortgaging the pink set and Water Works yields $215, bringing my cash to $718. That is still $292 short.

I will hold. I will not unmortgage New York or mortgage early to avoid interest. I will not sell Park Place, St. James Place, Tennessee Avenue, or the pink set to p4.

I considered trading for Virginia Avenue from p4. That would complete my pink monopoly and let me build on the orange set once New York is unmortgaged. p4 has three hotels and $1435, so they will not sell it cheaply.

I realized Indiana is red, not orange, confirming my orange monopoly is complete aside from the mortgaged New York. I am now evaluating specific trades: p2 has Boardwalk, so selling Park Place to p3 or p4 would leave them with only a dead property unless they also acquire Boardwalk. That would eliminate my inheritance play if p2 goes bankrupt to me.

p2 is unlikely to go bankrupt immediately. He could mortgage Reading, B&O, and Boardwalk for roughly $400, plus Marvin Gardens at $140, so he can raise cash before busting. I cannot buy the unowned Illinois or Atlantic from the bank unless I land on them.

I rejected p2's prior offer of Marvin Gardens plus $40. Virginia Avenue is a singleton pink blocker for p4, so they will not sell it cheaply. Even if I acquired it, completing the pink set would require $900 in houses, which I cannot afford alongside building on orange.

I am now considering selling St. Charles Place and States Avenue to p4 for cash. That would complete his pink monopoly, but he already has three hotels and $1435, so he could build pink hotels immediately and become even more dangerous. The only way this trade would help me is if the cash allowed me to build three houses on orange first and kill him before he could use the pink hotels.

Even $600 from p4 would leave me with only about $93 after paying to unmortgage New York and build three houses on orange. That is too little to survive a hotel hit before the orange rent pays off. I would need roughly $800 to have any real chance of surviving. Completing the pink set for p4 would give him a second monopoly, which is dangerous. The trade is too risky.

I will not complete the pink set for p4 unless the price is extraordinary. I am also considering trades with p3 and p2, but neither offers much of value to me.

I considered trading the pink set and cash for p2's Boardwalk. That would give me a dark blue monopoly with Park Place. But unmortgaging Park Place costs $193, and building one house on each dark blue property would cost $400. I cannot afford that.

I will end my turn. I will not trade for Boardwalk or sell the pink set. I will keep $503 as a buffer against p4's hotels and p3's Baltic. A $600 hotel hit is manageable. I can mortgage roughly $100 in properties to cover it.

Unmortgaging New York would leave me with only $608 after paying the $110 unmortgage fee. That barely covers a $600 hotel hit and still leaves no cash for building. Keeping New York mortgaged is strictly better than unmortgaging it without immediately building houses.

I am weighing whether to propose a trade. I could ask p4 for cash in exchange for my pink set, or offer Park Place to p2. I worry that a bad proposal might leak information or annoy the engine. I want to avoid giving away properties that would let an opponent build dangerous monopolies.

I calculated the exact costs of giving p2 Park Place. Unmortgaging it would cost $193, and building one house on each dark blue property would cost $400. Even if p2 paid me $200, he would have only $86 left after covering the unmortgage fee. He cannot afford to build houses on both properties. This makes a trade for Boardwalk or Park Place impossible.

p2 could mortgage his railroads and Marvin Gardens to raise roughly $340. He might pay me $150–200 for Park Place, unmortgage it for $193, and build one house on Boardwalk alone. That would cost about $200 and yield rent of $200, which is not immediately lethal. Building two houses on Boardwalk and one on Park Place would cost $600 and yield rent of $600 plus $175. He could reach that by mortgaging everything.

I will end my turn. I will not trade for Park Place because a dark blue monopoly would be too dangerous to match. I may stay silent or simply reiterate that the property is not for sale.
